apm3011.note: The project team proposed these University of Idaho APM 30.11 tiers; they are not institutional classification until the Data Owner approves them (issue #176). A table takes the highest tier of any of its columns.

tables.name: ai_edit_tasks
tables.description: Durable staff-only AI edit requests, bounded execution state, restart interruption and committed response copies; source-level retention applies.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Durable task UUID returned as Task_Id by the staff API.

columns.name: Submission_Id
columns.description: Parent source submission; task copies are deleted with the source.

columns.name: Newsletter_Type
columns.description: Publication context for this AI request.

columns.name: Editor_Instructions
columns.description: Staff-provided instructions, potentially containing unpublished copy or incidental personal data.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: Code-validated queued, running, succeeded or failed task state.

columns.name: Source_Fingerprint
columns.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of source copy, category, target, notes and links for stale-result checks.

columns.name: Active_Key
columns.description: Nullable unique submission/newsletter key preventing duplicate pending work.

columns.name: Run_Id
columns.description: Worker attempt UUID used to prevent late invalidated attempts from saving.

columns.name: Result_JSON
columns.description: Committed AI edit response including copy, links, flags, diffs and provenance; may repeat personal data.

columns.name: Error_Message
columns.description: Controlled application failure/retry message; external exception details are excluded.

columns.name: Updated_At
columns.description: Latest task transition timestamp in UTC.

tables.name: allowed_values
tables.description: Central governed value list for categorical fields, adapted from OpenERA AllowedValues.

columns.name: Value_Group
columns.description: Vocabulary family used by API, forms, and settings.

columns.name: Label
columns.description: Human-readable value shown in the user interface.

columns.name: Display_Order
columns.description: Sort order for menus and settings views.

columns.name: Is_Active
columns.description: Soft-disable flag for values that should no longer be selected.

columns.name: Visibility_Role
columns.description: Public or staff visibility scope for submission categories.

tables.name: audit_events
tables.steward: Security and operations owner / UCM Data Owner
tables.description: Append-only per-user trail of privileged-role API reads and exports, all writes and deletions, 401/403 refusals and sign-in outcomes. Holds no content, query strings, IP addresses or user agents; no update/delete API and no disposal job.

columns.name: Occurred_At
columns.description: UTC time the request completed or the sign-in finished.

columns.name: Actor_Ref
columns.description: Microsoft Entra object ID (oid) of the signed-in account; null in header mode, for anonymous callers and for sessions minted before the claim existed. Authorized Entra administrators can resolve it to a person, so it is handled as a personal identifier.

columns.name: Actor_Role
columns.description: Role resolved for the caller: staff, slc, ops, submitter or public.

columns.name: Event_Type
columns.description: Code-validated event: record_read, record_export, record_change, record_delete, authorization_failure, sign_in_success or sign_in_failure.

columns.name: Reason_Code
columns.description: Fixed reason for a refusal (unauthenticated, forbidden) or failed sign-in (sign_in_failed, no_account, misconfigured, unavailable).

columns.name: Http_Method
columns.description: HTTP method of the audited request.

columns.name: Route_Template
columns.description: Declared API route template, never the raw URL or query string.

columns.name: Record_Ids
columns.description: Path-parameter values shaped like record IDs (UUIDs or integers), keyed by parameter name; other path text is dropped.

columns.name: Changed_Fields
columns.description: Top-level JSON body key names of a write that the route's request schema declares; unknown keys and all values are dropped.

columns.name: Status_Code
columns.description: HTTP response status; null for sign-in events.

tables.name: blackout_dates
tables.description: Dates when one or all newsletters should not publish.

columns.name: Newsletter_Type
columns.description: Optional publication scope; null applies broadly.

tables.name: custom_publish_dates
tables.description: Ad hoc publish dates used during winter break or other non-standard schedules.

columns.name: Description
columns.description: Reason for the custom publish date.

tables.name: edit_versions
tables.description: Append-only snapshots of original, AI-suggested, and editor-final copy.

columns.name: Version_Type
columns.description: Editing stage represented by the snapshot.

columns.name: Headline_Case
columns.description: Headline casing policy applied to this version.

columns.name: Flags
columns.description: JSON list of AI or rule findings.

columns.name: Changes_Made
columns.description: JSON list of generated or editor-facing change summaries.

columns.name: AI_Provider
columns.description: LLM provider used for AI-generated versions.

columns.name: AI_Model
columns.description: LLM model used for AI-generated versions.

columns.name: Policy_Fingerprint
columns.description: Editorial policy version and hash of the active style rules behind an AI-generated version.

columns.name: Editor_Instructions
columns.description: Free-text editor instructions passed into an edit run.

tables.name: harvested_events
tables.description: External calendar occurrences with independent SLC and ops review lenses.

columns.name: Source_Url
columns.description: External source link; may include query parameters.

columns.name: Title
columns.description: Upstream public event title; can name people.

columns.name: Description
columns.description: Upstream event details; can include personal contact information.

columns.name: Content_Hash
columns.description: Hash of source content used to detect upstream changes.

columns.name: Ops_Assessed_Content_Hash
columns.description: Content hash used for current ops assessment.

columns.name: Upstream_Changed_At
columns.description: Time source changed after SLC flagging; cleared by SLC acknowledgment.

columns.name: Ops_Upstream_Changed_At
columns.description: Time source changed after ops review; cleared independently by ops.

columns.name: Promoted_Submission_Id
columns.description: SLC-only submission created by promotion; cleared if submission is deleted.

tables.name: newsletter_external_items
tables.description: Placement of imported calendar, job, or other external content into a newsletter issue.

columns.name: Source_Type
columns.description: External source category, such as calendar_event or job_posting.

tables.name: newsletter_items
tables.description: Placement of a finalized submission into a newsletter issue and section.

columns.name: Manually_Placed
columns.description: Staff changed section placement; automatic reassembly preserves it.

columns.name: Source_Version_Id
columns.description: Edit-version reference from which issue copy was assembled.

columns.name: Edition_Edited
columns.description: Staff changed issue copy; reassembly preserves the edition override.

columns.name: Upstream_Reviewed_Version_Id
columns.description: Approved revision reviewed and intentionally not applied to this issue.

tables.name: newsletter_sections
tables.description: Governed section taxonomy and layout requirements for each newsletter type.

columns.name: Requires_Image
columns.description: Whether items in the section need an image.

tables.name: newsletters
tables.description: Dated editions of The Daily Register or My UI.

tables.name: ops_need_assessments
tables.description: AI-suggested needs and staff verdicts for a harvested event.

columns.name: Harvested_Event_Id
columns.description: Parent harvested event reference; assessment cascades on event deletion.

columns.name: Confidence
columns.description: AI confidence code; null for staff-added needs.

columns.name: Rationale
columns.description: Model or staff explanation; can quote source content and contain personal information.

columns.name: Verdict
columns.description: Staff judgment of the suggested need.

columns.name: Source
columns.description: AI or staff origin of the assessment.

tables.name: product_feedback
tables.description: User reports and diagnostic context; only staff review the queue.

columns.name: Summary
columns.description: User-entered short report summary; can contain incidental personal information.

columns.name: Details
columns.description: User-entered report text; can contain incidental sensitive information.

columns.name: Submitter_Role
columns.description: Client-reported UI role; not an authenticated actor identity.

columns.name: Route
columns.description: Reported page route; free text from client, potentially identifying.

columns.name: GitHub_URL
columns.description: Optional engineering issue reference; review sharing permissions.

columns.name: GitHub_Export_Reviewed_At
columns.description: UTC time a staff-confirmed edited export was prepared; not proof an issue was posted.

columns.name: GitHub_Export_SHA256
columns.description: Fingerprint of the exact reviewed export artifact; report originals remain unchanged.

columns.name: Notification_Status
columns.description: Pending, disabled, failed or sent delivery state.

columns.name: Notification_Sent_At
columns.description: Latest successful delivery time, if any.

columns.name: Notification_Last_Error
columns.description: Exception class for latest delivery failure; older releases could store arbitrary error text.

tables.name: recurring_message_issue_overrides
tables.description: Issue-specific exceptions, currently used to preserve skipped recurring messages.

tables.name: recurring_messages
tables.description: Staff-managed reusable copy surfaced on a configured cadence.

tables.name: schedule_configs
tables.description: Publication cadence and submission deadline rules by newsletter type and schedule mode.

columns.name: Mode
columns.description: Academic year, summer, or winter break schedule mode.

columns.name: Is_Daily
columns.description: Whether the mode publishes every weekday.

tables.name: schedule_mode_overrides
tables.description: Manual date-range override that forces a newsletter into a configured schedule mode.

columns.name: Override_Mode
columns.description: Schedule mode to apply during the range.

tables.name: style_rules
tables.description: Database-managed style rules injected into the AI editing system prompt.

columns.name: Rule_Set
columns.description: Shared, TDR, or My UI rule scope.

columns.name: Is_Active
columns.description: Whether future AI edits should use the rule.

tables.name: submission_links
tables.description: Normalized hyperlinks attached to submitted content.

columns.name: Url
columns.description: Destination URL supplied with the submission.

columns.name: Anchor_Text
columns.description: Optional display text for the link.

columns.name: Display_Order
columns.description: Ordering of links inside the submission.

tables.name: submission_schedule_requests
tables.description: Requested run dates, recurrence settings, flexibility notes, and skipped occurrence dates.

columns.name: Second_Requested_Date
columns.description: Secondary requested date when an item targets both newsletters.

columns.name: Is_Flexible
columns.description: Whether editors may choose an alternate date.

columns.name: Flexible_Deadline
columns.description: Optional text describing the latest flexible publication deadline.

columns.name: Recurrence_Type
columns.description: Recurrence rule type for repeated runs.

columns.name: Repeats_Indefinitely
columns.description: Staff-only choice that a weekly or monthly schedule repeats with no end date; false keeps older open-ended rows running once.

columns.name: Excluded_Dates
columns.description: JSON list of skipped or rescheduled occurrence dates.

tables.name: submissions
tables.description: Submitted newsletter or SLC event content with workflow, submitter, image, and routing metadata.

columns.name: Target_Newsletter
columns.description: Publication routing code: TDR, My UI, both, or SLC-only none.

columns.name: Submitter_Notes
columns.description: Free-text instructions from submitter; may contain incidental PII.

columns.name: Editorial_Notes
columns.description: Staff-only editorial notes; may contain incidental PII.

columns.name: Has_Image
columns.description: Whether an uploaded image is attached.

columns.name: Image_Path
columns.description: Server-side image path using UUID naming.

columns.name: Survey_End_Date
columns.description: Optional survey close date used for survey handling.

columns.name: Show_In_SLC_Calendar
columns.description: Whether the submission appears in the SLC calendar feed.

columns.name: Event_Classification
columns.description: Strategic or signature event label for SLC visibility.

columns.name: Approved_Version_Id
columns.description: Explicit approved edit-version reference; cleared when a later draft is saved.
